approved_scope: Only the once-only, artifact-only original four32-AU prefix research attempt after parent records exact implementation source/PR review and preflight passes. This review is delegated source review, not independent GitHub approval or factual runtime acceptance.

checks.verdict: The held stock source emits declarations, blocks for its ACK, then enqueues that AU. The consumer persists/checks current declarations and preceding duration before ACK; it receives and hashes the current original header/text/full payload before FIFO submission or next ACK. It does not wait for a current binary before its enabling ACK.

One fixed original source child per run, original media/source hashes, native PTS and already-scaled transport PTS/DTS/duration, original keyframe flag and continuous cycle0 prefix. Exactly32 consecutive admissions, 31.5-second source window, actual duration-driven minimum999999600ns cadence, fixed original sequence9-24 central cohort; no additional ACK, replacement or search.

Fresh decoder/pipeline/source per fixed front/default,front/zero,underbody/zero,underbody/default order in one original owned container. Only supported max-display-delay changes; default remains unset. Packaged GI/Gst.init/source/plugin/library identities are pinned. No package installation, model inference or host decoder substitute.

Full32 input/sink/src/RGB unique PTS multiplicity, complete per-PTS active RGB hash/caps/geometry and paired presentation order. Sink/src probes use one guest monotonic clock before logging/hash; original actual decoder-sink EOS separates flush timing. Source realtime milliseconds, planned offsets and host clocks are not subtracted from decoder times. Hash/sample hold and appsrc blocking remain disclosed limitations.

Separate32-entry FIFO releases next ACK only after full preceding packet validation, without waiting for blocking appsrc. Original raw packet cap128MiB includes reserved80B failed-next-header space; before-read/ACK length/capacity checks precede allocation. Mapped RGB/payload64MiB, appsink/appsrc one buffer, event512x16KiB, channels1MiB, runs256MiB, two metadata namespaces16MiB each. These are admission caps, not total RSS or GPU internal-buffer proofs; no cgroup tuning.

Consumed malformed/truncated line and packet prefixes are preserved. New exclusive once-only attempt, no resume/retry/replacement or subsequent setting after failure. Actual source PIDs/groups/readers are bounded and joined; original daemon CID/name/hashlabel/image facts govern stop/remove. Successful daemon terminal inspection occurs before exact-ID removal and exact absence observation; cleanup requiring stop is a failed attempt.

Shared prelaunch120 seconds, startup45 including source/library pins and START, sourceEOF-through-feeder/decoder-drain10, owned cleanup15, each receipt-last run120 and whole receipt-last controller600. Conservative external elapsed-interval anchors avoid subtracting host/guest absolute clocks. Partial/unsealed phase documents never end a watchdog. Final receipt writes and hashes are checked within the original bound; a crossed bound emits failure/nonzero and preserves original terminal evidence.

Controller completion is explicitly provisional and binds original closed raw leaves. Root must independently cold hold/hash/replay those physical leaves and recompute source/probe/output identity, cohort/EOS, paired values and run bounds before drawing research conclusions. Observed pixel hashes are compared, not independently regenerated by cold redecoding. No benchmark/model/parity/qualification/Q4/full acceptance or scientific-regime adoption follows from successful research execution.
